_read_me: Settings for the artwork checker (/check). 'defaults' fill the form for a custom size. Add D2G products to 'products' so people can pick them by name. All sizes in mm; min_dpi = lowest acceptable resolution for photos at FULL printed size. Set 'confirmed' to true once D2G has checked these numbers: until then the page shows a 'draft settings' note.

products._example: copy this shape for each product, e.g.
products.name: Example: pull-up banner 850mm
